messages:
Mira Patel: Quick heads-up — kicking off a 'surgical prune' of admin entitlements across core infra next Mon. Primary goals: remove ownerless admins, validate KMS key bindings, and run least-priv checks. Plan: 2-week canary -> org-wide sweep. I’ll chair a triage meeting Wed 10am.

Samir Khan: +1. Can we add a last-used filter so we don't remove dormant but still-used service accounts? e.g., last 90d IAM activity + KMS usage.

Jules Rivera: I can draft the owner-notice template and a short FAQ. Will ping eng-tools to mass-notify role owners once we have the claim form.

ops-bot: automation kickoff scheduled: `2026-05-14T09:00:00Z` — running inventory collection for projects: core-* , infra-*. Posting initial counts when ready.

Samir Khan: quick Q — for keys that lack an explicit 'owner' label, what do we expect? tag+claim flow or automatic removal?

Mira Patel: Tag+claim preferred. Auto removal only if ownerless + unused > 180 days and no KMS usage in last 90d. For anything 30-180d we'll require justification and a ticket.

security-bot: Reminder: policy requires audit logs in BigQuery before irreversible edits. If `sec_audit_access` dataset not present for a project, the automation will abort for that project.

ops-bot: Running KMS usage scan (dry-run):
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"kms_crypto_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName:(\"Encrypt\" OR \"Decrypt\" OR \"Sign\")' --freshness=90d --format=json
```
Found 47 keys with no owner label in the inventory.

Eli Turner: I'll run a dev canary next Friday. Runbook snippet: `./scripts/prune-admins --project=project-dev --dry-run --report=dev-prune.csv`

Danya Brooks: I'll own rollback and incident playbook. Plan to post escalation steps to #incidents and set an alert if error-rate or latency increases after prune.

Samir Khan: Initial counts from my query (counts only):
- ownerless-admins: 63
- keys-with-missing-roles: 12
- svcacct-last-used>90d: 34

Mira Patel: Action items: (1) Samir — export KMS last-used CSV and attach to the canary ticket. (2) Jules — owner-claim form + notification template. (3) Eli — run dev canary and share `--dry-run` results. (4) Danya — rollback playbook + alerts. I'll update the org-level runbook and do the final signoff.

Jules Rivera: Will create the Google form and drop link here by EOD. Template will include a required justification field and owner email.

security-bot: Operational note: do not remove bindings if audit shows a key was used in last 30 days. If a binding removal is requested and usage exists, it will be blocked and flagged for manual review.

Mira Patel: Also — make sure `sec_audit_access.kms_logs` is reachable from the incident runbooks. Example check: `SELECT count(*) FROM \\`sec_audit_access.kms_logs\\` WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%Encrypt%' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)` — if returns NULL/0, abort prune.

Eli Turner: :thumbsup: will run the check and report back.

Jules Rivera: :thumbsup: form link posted — https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/example-owner-claim

Mira Patel: OK team — sync Friday 09:00 to review dry-run CSV and decide canary go/no-go. Ping me in-thread for any blockers. Thanks all.
